title: Priceless desktop experience
slide_intent: Show circles shaping a digital layout because identity geometry can guide composition beyond the logo.
strategic_value: An oversized circle crop can connect photography and typography while retaining brand character.
demonstration: A desktop screen pairs a blue photographic circular crop with a dark text region against an orange backdrop.
practical_value: Inspect how a circle becomes the boundary between image and message.

content_islands.name: Device and ground
content_islands.spec: Center the desktop display on the orange background.

content_islands.name: Screen composition
content_islands.spec: Use the large curved image edge at left and the white shopping headline at right; retain the small header navigation.

reference_purposes.Application: The artwork shows a Priceless digital experience on a desktop display.
reference_purposes.Expression: The composition enlarges circular geometry into an image boundary.
reference_purposes.Intent: Pentagram states that the system extends logo geometry and color into graphic tools for consistent communication across media.
